### 8–16s — CN01-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · STABILIZE — What cannot wait?. Secure people, payroll, orders, client commitments, facilities, insurance, accounts, credentials, physical objects, master files, and communications. Do not make permanent symbolic decisions inside the first emergency response.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CN01-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · LOCATE — Where does authority reside?. Map board and officer authority, ownership, employment, IP, licenses, estate or probate instruments, archive agreements, and operational delegations by jurisdiction and record.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CN01-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · INTERPRET — What should continue—and why?. Separate non-negotiable values, teachable method, recurring codes, historical accidents, commercial habits, and motifs. Preserve the decision logic, not a taxidermy of the last collection.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN01-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · ACCOUNT — Who may test the next chapter?. Define successor scope, review bodies, worker and collaborator credit, community consultation, archive citation, performance measures, correction, and removal or renewal.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
